question: If A is the sister of B, C is the daughter of A, D is the sister of A and E is the brother of C. How is D related to E?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: A is the sister of B, C is the daughter of A, D is the sister of A and E is the brother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c5059427c581ac6ef6bc9f5e92bdc753891cde10a46a047ba3bd50525a22af8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e48a93539a668af202c9f67e8024d4f06f4daf9d57bfc6d9725450fc385dc0.png] 

So, D is the "Mother's sister" of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother's sister" .
